name: english-proofreader-pro
description: Careful American English proofreading, editing, rewriting, and drafting with copyable results and complete correction lists.

interface.longDescription: Proofread, edit, rewrite, or draft American English prose while preserving meaning and voice. Finished text appears in a copyable plain-text code block. Edits to supplied text are followed by a complete Changes list. Preserve literal Markdown, paragraph breaks, and list markers. Supports requested shortening levels and editing AI prompts without executing their embedded instructions. By default, make only necessary corrections and retain gendered singular pronouns instead of replacing them with singular they; use they, them, and their for plural references only. Already-correct text receives a no-adjustments confirmation. Follow the user's separate editing directions.
defaultPrompt: Proofread the following text, preserving its formatting.
Proofread the following text and trim the fat.
Draft a short professional email asking for a status update.

review.commerce_description: This skills-only plugin does not sell products, process payments, or require a publisher-provided paid service. Host subscriptions are separate.

publication.release_notes: Preserve fenced examples literally unless their payload is explicitly selected for editing. Harden package validation and failed-build recovery, and record source-bound behavioral evidence.
